name: RF and Microwave Active Circuits
description: Introduction to the course; review of basics such as transmission lines, Smith chart, matching network, and S-parameters; basics of RF and microwave transistor amplifier design including gain derivations and stability circles; design of various types of RF and microwave transistor amplifier such as narrowband, broadband, low noise, and power amplifiers; two stage RF and microwave amplifiers; RF and microwave switches and phase shifters; and introduction to other active component(s) (for example mixers etc.).
